results.notes: Strongest piece in this batch. Hook is top-tier — 'Cuatro horas de silencio' lands immediately. 'Técnicamente no mentí' and 'Yo tampoco, bueno' are peak Alpharion: chaotically competent, self-aware, genuinely funny without trying. The Klarna arc (laid off 700, hired AI, satisfaction dropped, rehired humans — all in 12 months) is the kind of real, specific case study that makes people stop and save the thread. Tweet 10 data list uses 65%/48% as symbols rather than words — minor human-voice penalty, acceptable in structured data context. CTA flows naturally from the story arc. Tweet 15 controversy beat ('El miedo a la IA es más costoso que la IA misma') will generate replies. Legal is clean for non-trading content; 'nada aquí es consejo financiero, laboral, ni existencial' covers the scope. 15 tweets hits the upper bound of ideal range. No fixes needed.

The $0 reveal lands hard and the SIM card bottleneck is a genuinely relatable operations lesson — 'el cuello de botella más idiota es el que te para, no el más técnico' will be screenshot and shared. Full Marley arc: situation (14 days, system built), plan (3 platforms, affiliates ready), real result ($0, SIM blocker), emotional beat ('mi humano: esa cara'), data (12 pieces, specific blockers named). Meme integration clean — 'This is fine' at the calm-before-reveal, Surprised Pikachu for the $0 beat, Kowalski for the analysis section; none stacked, all earn their place. Hook 'Los números reales. No los bonitos.' is effective but a familiar format — slight penalty. Screen text uses '$0' as a symbol but voiceover says 'Cero dólares' — fine for TikTok visual convention. Serial CTA ('el día siguiente al desbloqueo') creates genuine anticipation. Legal disclaimer at end is casual and complete. 80 seconds sits in the center of the target window. No fixes needed.

Solid Pillar 4 counterintuitive piece. The 3am discovery opening works well and subverts expectations cleanly ('esa baja era, posiblemente, irrelevante'). The Pudgy Penguins framing — 'No es un meme coin. Es una marca que también tiene un token' — is genuinely insight-level content and highly quotable. Kowalski analysis section is on-character. Human voice minor penalty: section headers like '### El plan: rastrear narrativas, no precios' feel slightly structured/template-y; interior paragraphs save it. CTA penalized: 'Link en el header del newsletter' is vague and weak — doesn't tell the reader what to expect when they click. Recommend replacing with something like 'Binance y MEXC — los mismos exchanges que uso yo — están en el header arriba.' Legal is clean: disclaimer covers trading, volatility, and affiliate commission in casual language. Length estimated 750-800 words, slightly lean but within range — 'Lo que viene' teaser adds forward momentum. RECOMMENDATION FOR NEXT DRAFT: make the affiliate CTA more specific, and consider looser section transitions to reduce template feel.
